resources.string: Review and explicitly apply supported Android privacy controls. No changes are made until you change a control.
This Settings page is unavailable on this build.
Experimental AOSP-based build. GrapheneOS-inspired appearance does not provide GrapheneOS device hardening. Per-app permissions and remaining privacy controls stay in Android Settings.

Allows GhostOS to apply explicitly selected camera, screen-capture, microphone-unmute, location, supported USB data and secure lock-screen notification restrictions when provisioned as Device Owner. No policy is applied automatically.

Device Owner is active. Supported camera, screen-capture, microphone-unmute, location, USB data and secure lock-screen notification controls can be changed individually below. Full GhostMode remains inactive.
Device Owner provisioning is required before these Android-enforced controls can be changed. No policy is applied automatically.
The GhostMode device administrator is inactive. No policy was changed.
Android DevicePolicyManager is unavailable or policy state could not be read. No protection is assumed.
Explicit GhostMode device controls are applied. The original device settings are saved and can be restored below.
GhostMode recovery is required. Restore the saved device settings before relying on protection.

These are individual Device Owner controls only. Location control appears only on Android 11 or later; USB data control appears only when Android reports device support. Lock-screen notification redaction applies only on secure keyguard screens. Network, clipboard, sensor permissions and full preset orchestration remain unimplemented.
Microphone unmute restriction applied. This does not mute an active microphone.
USB data signaling disabled; charging remains available.
Redact sensitive notifications on secure lock screen
Android now limits secure lock-screen notifications to redacted content.
Android lock-screen notification redaction restriction removed.
Android rejected the change; the previous state was restored.
Policy change failed and rollback was incomplete. Verify Android policy state before relying on protection.

Opens GhostOS Privacy Center. Supported Device Owner camera, microphone-unmute, location, screen-capture, USB data and secure lock-screen notification controls are available individually after provisioning. Remaining GhostMode controls are not connected or enforced yet; network, sensor and clipboard policies are not fully integrated. This tile is not an activation switch.
